skill.name: cold-email
skill.description: Draft concise cold emails using AIDA, PAS, or BAB frameworks with personalized openers, clear value, and one direct call to action.
skill.summary: Create short, personalized cold emails with proven copywriting frameworks.
skill.author: humanizerai

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives in context. The backtick pattern is a Markdown output example, and the research phrase is normal personalization guidance for cold email writing.

finding_verdicts.reason: Lines 59-65 are a fenced Markdown output template, not Ruby or shell execution. There is no executable script, command interpolation, or instruction to run a command.
Line 53 uses research as a recipient-personalization quality standard for outreach. It does not instruct system, host, network, or account reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Cold outreach often sounds generic and asks too much. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft concise, personalized emails with one clear call to action.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 50-125 word cold emails for a stated target and goal.
Chooses between AIDA, PAS, and BAB copywriting frameworks.
Creates short subject lines with no clickbait.
Uses provided personalization hooks in the opening line.
Includes one specific call to action and a word count.
limitations: Requires accurate target details and context from the user.
Does not verify recipient data, laws, or deliverability requirements.
Does not send emails or connect to email platforms.
Cannot guarantee replies or campaign performance.

use_cases.title: Book Discovery Calls
use_cases.description: Create a short outreach email that invites a prospect to discuss a relevant business problem.

use_cases.title: Request Expert Feedback
use_cases.description: Write a respectful email asking a domain expert for focused feedback on a product or idea.

use_cases.title: Start Partnership Outreach
use_cases.description: Draft a concise first message that explains mutual value and suggests a simple next step.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Outreach Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you have the recipient, goal, and one personalization hook.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a cold email to [target role] at [company]. Goal: [meeting, feedback, intro, or sale]. Personalization: [specific reason for reaching out].

prompt_templates.title: Framework Choice
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you want the skill to choose the strongest copywriting framework.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cold email for [target]. Goal: [goal]. Context: [pain point, recent news, or mutual connection]. Choose AIDA, PAS, or BAB and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Revise Existing Email
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when an existing draft is too long or too generic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this cold email to follow the skill rules. Keep it under 125 words, add one specific opener, and use one CTA: [paste draft].

prompt_templates.title: Campaign Variant Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when testing different angles for the same prospect type.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write three cold email variants for [target segment]. Goal: [goal]. Context: [personalization details]. Use AIDA, PAS, and BAB once each.

output_examples.input: Target: VP of Operations at a logistics company. Goal: book a meeting. Context: recent expansion into new regions.
output_examples.output:
Subject: new route planning

Saw your team expanded into two new regions this quarter. Teams often hit planning delays when dispatch rules change across markets.

We help operations teams reduce manual route review without replacing their existing TMS.

Would a 15 minute call next week be useful to compare where delays usually appear?

Sam

Framework used: PAS
Personalization: regional expansion
Word count: 71

output_examples.input: Target: product leader. Goal: request feedback. Context: they wrote about onboarding friction.
output_examples.output:
Subject: onboarding question

Your post about onboarding friction matched a problem we are studying right now.

We are building a tool that helps teams spot where new users lose momentum before activation.

Could I send a two minute overview and ask one question about the workflow you described?

Maya

Framework used: AIDA
Personalization: published onboarding post
Word count: 66

best_practices: Provide a real personalization hook for each recipient.
Use one clear request that is easy to answer.
Review all claims for accuracy before sending.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for multiple actions in one email.
Do not invent personalization details or business claims.
Do not use hype, pressure, or misleading subject lines.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target role, company or segment, goal, and one specific personalization hook.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it use?
faq.answer: It can use AIDA, PAS, or BAB and should choose the best fit for the outreach goal.

faq.question: Can it write follow-up emails?
faq.answer: Yes, provide the original message, timing, and desired next step.

faq.question: Does it send emails?
faq.answer: No. It only drafts text for review and use in your own email tools.

faq.question: Can it ensure legal compliance?
faq.answer: No. Users must review outreach for applicable consent, unsubscribe, and marketing rules.

faq.question: Will it guarantee replies?
faq.answer: No. It improves message structure, but replies depend on targeting, timing, offer, and list quality.
